name: ai-toolkit-for-fractal
description: Fractal Audio knowledge, preset planning and controlled MIDI access for FM9, FM3 and Axe-Fx III.
long_description: Contains the provider-independent toolkit, complete source, helpers and retained references. Configure the device; its USB MIDI connection is found automatically by name, and enable live reads and write execution independently. Claude tool permissions control calls; hardware execution additionally requires one exact locally approved review. Enabling access never opens ports at startup. Claude manages Python through UV; .NET 10 is required for the contained helpers. No AI SDK, API key or other repository is required. Setup errors are reported through fractal_status while knowledge tools stay available and device access stays disabled.

allow_live_reads.title: Enable live MIDI reads
allow_live_reads.description: Allows read tools for the configured device. Claude tool permissions still apply. Startup opens no ports.

allow_writes.title: Enable MIDI write execution
allow_writes.description: Requires live reads and an exact operator-approved review. Claude Allow does not create that approval. Turn this off for read-only use.

device_model.title: Device model
device_model.description: Enter FM9, FM3 or Axe-Fx III. Uppercase and lowercase both work.

preset_capacity.title: Preset capacity
preset_capacity.description: 512 for FM9/FM3; actual 512 or 1024 capacity for Axe-Fx III.

firmware.title: Recorded firmware version
firmware.description: Enter the version shown on your device, such as 12.0 or 12.00. Both formats work; no firmware version is assumed.

midi_connection.title: MIDI connection (optional)
midi_connection.description: Leave Automatic when connecting your Fractal device by USB. The toolkit finds the connection by name. For a separate MIDI interface or several devices, enter its connection name. You do not need port numbers.
